# chronosphere_synthetic_test (Resource)

A synthetic test that probes an endpoint from Chronosphere-operated locations and alerts on the result.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chronosphere_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

resource "chronosphere_collection" "checkout" {
  name    = "Checkout"
  team_id = chronosphere_team.platform.id
}

variable "checkout_probe_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "chronosphere_synthetic_test" "checkout_availability" {
  name          = "Checkout availability"
  collection_id = chronosphere_collection.checkout.id
  test_type     = "HTTP"
  status        = "ENABLED"
  locations     = ["GCP_US_OREGON", "GCP_US_VIRGINIA"]
  interval_secs = 60
  timeout_secs  = 30

  retry_config {
    max_retries       = 2
    retry_interval_ms = 500
  }

  http_test {
    url          = "https://example.com/checkout/health"
    method       = "GET"
    http_version = "HTTP_2"

    authentication {
      basic_auth {
        username = "probe"
        # Write-only: supplied on every apply, never written to state. Bump
        # password_wo_version to roll out a new password.
        password_wo         = var.checkout_probe_password
        password_wo_version = 1
      }
    }

    assertions {
      status_code_assertion {
        operator = "EQUALS"
        target   = "200"
      }
    }

    assertions {
      response_time_assertion {
        operator  = "LESS_THAN"
        target_ms = 1500
        scope     = "WITHOUT_DNS"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) ID of the collection that owns this synthetic test.
- `interval_secs` (Number) How often the test runs, in seconds.
- `locations` (List of String) Probe locations the test runs from. Each location executes the test independently.
- `name` (String) Display name of the synthetic test. Can be changed after creation.
- `test_type` (String) Protocol exercised by the test: `HTTP`, `DNS`, `TCP`, or `TLS`. Must match the protocol block set below.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Free-form description of the synthetic test.
- `dns_test` (Block List, Max: 1) DNS resolution configuration. Set when `test_type` is `DNS`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--dns_test))
- `http_test` (Block List, Max: 1) HTTP request configuration. Set when `test_type` is `HTTP`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--http_test))
- `labels` (Map of String) Key/value labels attached to the synthetic test. Visible in notifications and usable for routing overrides in notification policies.
- `monitor_config` (Block List, Max: 1) Alerting behaviour derived from the test's pass/fail results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--monitor_config))
- `retry_config` (Block List, Max: 1) Retry behaviour applied to a failing run before it is reported as a failure. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retry_config))
- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the synthetic test. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation.
- `status` (String) Whether the test executes on its schedule (`ENABLED`) or is suspended (`PAUSED`).
- `tcp_test` (Block List, Max: 1) TCP connection configuration. Set when `test_type` is `TCP`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tcp_test))
- `timeout_secs` (Number) Per-run timeout in seconds, between 1 and 60. Defaults to 60.
- `tls_test` (Block List, Max: 1) TLS handshake configuration. Set when `test_type` is `TLS`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tls_test))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

Required:

Optional:

- `dns_server` (String) DNS server queried. Defaults to the probe's resolver.
- `dns_server_port` (Number) Port on `dns_server` to query.

<a id="nestedblock--dns_test--assertions--dns_record_assertion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_test.assertions.dns_record_assertion`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Comparison applied to the record values.
- `record_type` (String) Record type evaluated, e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`.
- `target` (String) Value compared against the records, or regular expression when `operator` is a regex comparison.

<a id="nestedblock--http_test--authentication--api_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http_test.authentication.api_token_auth`

Required:

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `key` (String) Header name carrying the token, e.g. `Authorization` or `X-API-Key`.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Full header value, e.g. `Bearer <secret>`. Treated as a secret in its entirety. Write-only: never stored in Terraform state, and never returned by the API. Terraform cannot see it change, so editing it alone produces no plan: bump `token_wo_version` to roll the new value out.

Optional:

- `token_wo_version` (Number) Increment this whenever `token_wo` changes. Terraform cannot detect a change to a write-only attribute on its own, so bumping this is what turns an edit to `token_wo` into a plan; whatever the attribute holds at apply time is then sent. The API does not store the version, so an imported test starts at 0 and its first plan shows a diff here.

### Nested Schema for `tls_test.assertions.cert_property_assertion`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Comparison applied to the property value.
- `property` (String) Certificate property evaluated, e.g. `issuer` or `subject`.
- `target` (String) Value compared against the property, or regular expression when `operator` is a regex comparison.


<a id="nestedblock--tls_test--assertions--certificate_assertion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls_test.assertions.certificate_assertion`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Comparison applied to the expiry: `EXPIRES_IN_LESS_THAN_DAYS` or `EXPIRES_IN_MORE_THAN_DAYS`.
- `target_days` (Number) Number of days compared against.


<a id="nestedblock--tls_test--assertions--response_time_assertion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls_test.assertions.response_time_assertion`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Comparison applied to the measured response time. Only `LESS_THAN` is currently supported.
- `scope` (String) Whether DNS resolution time counts towards the measured response time: `INCLUDING_DNS` or `WITHOUT_DNS`.
- `target_ms` (Number) Response time threshold in milliseconds.


<a id="nestedblock--tls_test--assertions--tls_version_assertion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls_test.assertions.tls_version_assertion`

Required:

- `bound` (String) Whether `target` is the minimum (`MIN`) or maximum (`MAX`) acceptable version.
- `operator` (String) Comparison applied to the negotiated version.
- `target` (String) TLS version compared against: `TLS_1_0` through `TLS_1_3`.
